allowed_changes: at the first execution session of each new calendar month, rank gold_cny, Nasdaq, S&P 500, CSI300 and Shanghai Composite by the immediately preceding complete calendar-month CNY close-to-close return
hold 100% of the single highest-return asset for the new month only when its prior-month return is strictly positive
hold CashYieldCNY when no candidate has a positive prior-month return
trade only when the selected owner changes; do not force monthly turnover when the owner is unchanged
compare with one annually rebalanced 20% each five-asset control and one CNY cash control
use product-level 1.00% fee and 0.05% slippage with no cost grid
comparison_gates: CAGR > annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
Sharpe > annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
MDD <= annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
expected_outputs: short-momentum, annual-equal and CNY-cash portfolio CSVs
actual trade count, owner-by-month audit, average cash, realized max gross, minimum cash and target fingerprint
global post-protocol DSR after the formal run
run authorization, execution commit and SHA artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After any formal performance metric is viewed, do not change the one-month horizon, monthly decision date, asset universe, winner count, weighting, positive-return cash gate, fee/slippage or add any filter in this lineage. A different horizon or ensemble is a separate literature-motivated preregistered lineage, not a rescue of this result.
forbidden_changes: skip-month, excluding the most recent week, or mixing multiple momentum horizons
top-2/top-3 ownership, inverse-volatility sizing, risk parity or volatility targeting
changing or dropping any of the five asset roles after results
turning the positive-return cash gate into a threshold search
changing review cadence, adding hysteresis, or changing fee/slippage after results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, gross exposure above 100% or negative cash
hypothesis: Published multi-asset evidence reports that, unlike stock-level short-term reversal, the most recent month return positively predicts future performance across major asset classes. At each month boundary, allocating the full unlevered portfolio to the single asset with the strongest strictly positive return over the immediately preceding complete calendar month may capture this short-horizon information diffusion while a cash fallback avoids forcing exposure when all candidates fell.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Zaremba, Karathanasopoulos & Long, Short-term momentum (almost) everywhere, Journal of International Financial Markets Institutions and Money 2019
selection_metric: No horizon or universe search. One immediately-prior-complete-calendar-month signal only; one positive leader or cash. Validation, objective attainment and annual-equal comparison are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.review: first execution session of each new calendar month

strategy_lineage: short-momentum-001 / 跨资产短期动量001; one-complete-calendar-month leader persistence
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_short_momentum_001.py -> tools/short_momentum_001.swiftpart + tools/short_momentum_001_logic.swift -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace with immediately-prior-complete-calendar-month selection
